supino-reto-barra.name: barbell bench press
supino-reto-barra.scene: a flat bench with a loaded barbell on a rack
supino-reto-barra.start: lying on his back on the flat bench, eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor, gripping the barbell slightly wider than shoulder width, the bar held straight above the shoulders with arms extended
supino-reto-barra.end: lowers the bar slowly in a straight line to the middle of the chest, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso
supino-reto-barra.checks: Pés no chão, escápulas encaixadas, barra desce no meio do peito, punhos retos, cotovelos ~45° do tronco

supino-inclinado-barra.name: incline barbell bench press
supino-inclinado-barra.scene: an incline bench (about 30 degrees) with a loaded barbell on a rack
supino-inclinado-barra.start: lying on the incline bench, feet flat on the floor, gripping the barbell slightly wider than shoulder width, arms extended above the upper chest
supino-inclinado-barra.end: lowers the bar slowly to the upper chest, just below the collarbones
supino-inclinado-barra.checks: Banco ~30°, barra desce na parte alta do peito, punhos retos, sem tirar o quadril do banco

supino-declinado-barra.name: decline barbell bench press
supino-declinado-barra.scene: a decline bench with a loaded barbell on a rack
supino-declinado-barra.start: lying on the decline bench with the legs hooked under the pads, gripping the barbell slightly wider than shoulder width, arms extended above the lower chest
supino-declinado-barra.end: lowers the bar slowly to the lower chest
supino-declinado-barra.checks: Pernas presas, barra desce na parte baixa do peito, movimento controlado

supino-reto-halteres.name: flat dumbbell bench press
supino-reto-halteres.start: lying on his back on the flat bench, feet flat on the floor, a dumbbell in each hand held above the chest with arms extended, palms facing his feet
supino-reto-halteres.end: lowers both dumbbells slowly to the sides of the chest, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso
supino-reto-halteres.checks: Halteres descem na linha do peito, cotovelos ~45°, sem bater os halteres em cima

supino-inclinado-halteres.name: incline dumbbell bench press
supino-inclinado-halteres.scene: an adjustable bench, inclined about 30 degrees
supino-inclinado-halteres.start: lying on the incline bench, feet flat on the floor, a dumbbell in each hand above the upper chest with arms extended
supino-inclinado-halteres.end: lowers both dumbbells slowly to the sides of the upper chest
supino-inclinado-halteres.checks: Banco ~30°, descida controlada até a linha do peito, punhos retos

supino-maquina.name: machine chest press
supino-maquina.start: seated on the chest press machine, back flat against the pad, feet on the floor, hands on the handles at chest height, elbows bent
supino-maquina.end: pushes both handles forward until the arms are almost straight, without locking the elbows
supino-maquina.checks: Costas apoiadas, pegadores na altura do peito, sem travar os cotovelos

supino-elastico.name: standing resistance band chest press
supino-elastico.scene: a resistance band anchored at chest height to the frame behind him
supino-elastico.start: standing in a split stance, one foot forward, holding a handle of the band in each hand beside the chest, elbows bent, the band coming from behind
supino-elastico.end: presses both hands straight forward at chest height until the arms are extended
supino-elastico.checks: Tronco firme, um pé à frente, empurra na altura do peito, volta controlando o elástico

flexao.name: push-up
flexao.start: in a high plank on the floor, hands slightly wider than the shoulders, arms straight, body in one straight line from head to heels
flexao.end: bends the elbows and lowers the whole body as one piece until the chest is close to the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso
flexao.rule: The hips never sag or pike; the body moves as one rigid plank.
flexao.checks: Corpo alinhado (sem quadril caído ou empinado), cotovelos ~45°, peito perto do chão

flexao-joelhos.name: knee push-up
flexao-joelhos.start: hands on the floor slightly wider than the shoulders, arms straight, knees on the floor, feet lifted, body straight from head to knees
flexao-joelhos.end: bends the elbows and lowers the chest toward the floor, body straight from head to knees
flexao-joelhos.checks: Linha reta da cabeça aos joelhos, cotovelos ~45°

flexao-inclinada.name: incline push-up with hands on a bench
flexao-inclinada.start: hands on the edge of the bench shoulder-width apart, arms straight, feet on the floor behind him, body in one straight line
flexao-inclinada.end: bends the elbows and lowers the chest to the edge of the bench, body straight
flexao-inclinada.checks: Corpo alinhado, peito vai até o banco, cotovelos ~45°

flexao-declinada.name: decline push-up with feet on a bench
flexao-declinada.start: feet on the bench, hands on the floor slightly wider than the shoulders, arms straight, body in one straight line angled downward
flexao-declinada.end: bends the elbows and lowers the chest toward the floor, body straight
flexao-declinada.checks: Corpo alinhado, sem arquear a lombar, descida controlada

mergulho-paralelas.name: parallel bar dips
mergulho-paralelas.start: supported on straight arms on the parallel bars, feet off the floor, knees slightly bent, torso leaning slightly forward
mergulho-paralelas.end: bends the elbows and lowers the body until the elbows reach about 90 degrees
mergulho-paralelas.checks: Tronco levemente inclinado, desce até ~90° de cotovelo, ombros longe das orelhas

crucifixo-halteres.name: flat dumbbell fly
crucifixo-halteres.start: lying on his back on the flat bench, feet on the floor, dumbbells together above the chest, palms facing each other, elbows slightly bent
crucifixo-halteres.end: opens both arms in a wide arc out to the sides, elbows kept slightly bent, until the dumbbells reach chest level
crucifixo-halteres.checks: Cotovelos levemente flexionados e fixos, abre até a linha do peito, sem descer demais

crucifixo-inclinado-halteres.name: incline dumbbell fly
crucifixo-inclinado-halteres.scene: an adjustable bench, inclined about 30 degrees
crucifixo-inclinado-halteres.start: lying on the incline bench, dumbbells together above the upper chest, palms facing each other, elbows slightly bent
crucifixo-inclinado-halteres.end: opens both arms in a wide arc out to the sides, elbows slightly bent
crucifixo-inclinado-halteres.checks: Cotovelos fixos levemente flexionados, amplitude confortável para o ombro

voador.name: pec deck machine fly
voador.start: seated on the pec deck facing the camera, back against the pad, arms open to the sides holding the handles at chest height, elbows slightly bent
voador.end: brings both handles together in front of the chest in a wide arc
voador.checks: Costas apoiadas, cotovelos na altura do peito, volta controlada

crossover-polia.name: cable crossover
crossover-polia.scene: a dual cable crossover station, handles at the top on both sides
crossover-polia.start: standing in the middle of the station facing the camera, one foot forward, torso leaning slightly forward, holding a high handle in each hand with the arms open to the sides, elbows slightly bent
crossover-polia.end: brings both hands down and together in a wide arc until they meet in front of the hips
crossover-polia.checks: Tronco levemente inclinado, cotovelos levemente flexionados, movimento em arco

supino-inclinado-maquina.name: incline machine chest press
supino-inclinado-maquina.start: seated on the incline chest press machine, back flat against the inclined pad, feet on the floor, hands on the handles at upper chest height, elbows bent
supino-inclinado-maquina.end: pushes both handles up and forward until the arms are almost straight, without locking the elbows
supino-inclinado-maquina.checks: Costas apoiadas, pegadores na altura da parte alta do peito, sem travar os cotovelos

supino-smith.name: Smith machine bench press
supino-smith.scene: a Smith machine with a flat bench under the bar
supino-smith.start: lying on his back on the flat bench under the Smith machine bar, feet flat on the floor, gripping the bar slightly wider than shoulder width, arms extended above the chest
supino-smith.end: lowers the bar along the guide rails to the middle of the chest, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso
supino-smith.checks: Barra desce no meio do peito, cotovelos ~45° do tronco, punhos retos, pés no chão

supino-chao-halteres.name: dumbbell floor press
supino-chao-halteres.start: lying on his back on the floor, knees bent with feet flat, a dumbbell in each hand held above the chest with arms extended, palms facing his feet
supino-chao-halteres.end: lowers both dumbbells until the upper arms lightly touch the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from the torso, forearms vertical
supino-chao-halteres.rule: The upper arms stop on the floor; the dumbbells never go lower than that.
supino-chao-halteres.checks: Braços encostam no chão e param, cotovelos ~45°, punhos retos

mergulho-assistido.name: assisted dip on an assisted dip machine
mergulho-assistido.scene: an assisted pull-up and dip machine with a knee pad
mergulho-assistido.start: kneeling on the assistance pad of the machine, hands on the dip handles, arms straight supporting the body, torso slightly leaning forward
mergulho-assistido.end: bends the elbows and lowers the body until the elbows reach about 90 degrees, knees staying on the pad
mergulho-assistido.checks: Joelhos no apoio, desce até ~90° de cotovelo, ombros longe das orelhas

puxada-frontal.name: lat pulldown
puxada-frontal.start: seated at the lat pulldown, thighs under the pads, torso upright and slightly leaning back, gripping the long bar overhead wider than the shoulders, arms straight
puxada-frontal.end: pulls the bar down in front of the face to the upper chest, elbows driving down and back, chest lifted
puxada-frontal.checks: Peito aberto, puxa até a parte alta do peito, sem jogar o tronco para trás

puxada-supinada.name: underhand lat pulldown
puxada-supinada.start: seated at the lat pulldown, thighs under the pads, holding the bar overhead with palms facing him, hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight
puxada-supinada.end: pulls the bar down to the upper chest, elbows moving down close to the body
puxada-supinada.checks: Pegada supinada, cotovelos descem junto ao corpo, volta controlada

puxada-triangulo.name: close-grip lat pulldown with V-handle
puxada-triangulo.scene: a lat pulldown machine with a V-handle attached
puxada-triangulo.start: seated at the lat pulldown, thighs under the pads, holding the V-handle overhead with both hands, arms straight
puxada-triangulo.end: pulls the handle down to the upper chest, elbows close to the body
puxada-triangulo.checks: Tronco firme, puxa até o peito, sem embalo

puxada-elastico.name: resistance band lat pulldown
puxada-elastico.scene: a resistance band anchored high on the frame above him
puxada-elastico.start: kneeling on the floor facing the camera, holding a handle of the band in each hand with the arms extended overhead in a V
puxada-elastico.end: pulls both elbows down and out until the hands are beside the shoulders
puxada-elastico.checks: Cotovelos descem para o lado do corpo, peito aberto, volta controlada

barra-fixa.name: pull-up
barra-fixa.start: hanging from the pull-up bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than the shoulders, arms straight, feet off the floor, legs still
barra-fixa.end: pulls the body straight up until the chin passes over the bar, without swinging
barra-fixa.rule: No swinging and no kicking: the legs stay still.
barra-fixa.checks: Sem balanço, sobe até o queixo passar a barra, desce até estender os braços

barra-fixa-supinada.name: chin-up
barra-fixa-supinada.start: hanging from the pull-up bar with an underhand grip, palms facing him, hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight, legs still
barra-fixa-supinada.end: pulls the body straight up until the chin passes over the bar, without swinging
barra-fixa-supinada.rule: No swinging and no kicking: the legs stay still.
barra-fixa-supinada.checks: Sem balanço, pegada supinada, descida controlada

barra-fixa-negativa.name: negative pull-up
barra-fixa-negativa.start: holding himself at the top of a pull-up, chin above the bar, overhand grip, legs still
barra-fixa-negativa.end: lowers the body very slowly, the arms straightening little by little
barra-fixa-negativa.rule: Only the lowering phase: he does not pull back up.
barra-fixa-negativa.checks: Descida lenta (~4 s), corpo firme, sem soltar de uma vez

remada-curvada-barra.name: bent-over barbell row
remada-curvada-barra.start: standing with knees slightly bent, hips pushed back, torso leaning forward about 45 degrees with a flat back, holding the barbell with an overhand grip, arms hanging straight
remada-curvada-barra.end: pulls the bar to the lower ribs, elbows driving back past the torso
remada-curvada-barra.rule: The torso angle never changes; only the arms move.
remada-curvada-barra.checks: Coluna neutra, tronco ~45°, puxa a barra até o abdômen, sem dar tranco

remada-cavalinho.name: T-bar row
remada-cavalinho.start: straddling the T-bar, knees bent, torso leaning forward with a flat back, holding the handle with arms straight
remada-cavalinho.end: pulls the handle up to the chest, elbows driving back
remada-cavalinho.checks: Coluna neutra, tronco firme, puxa com as costas, não com a lombar

remada-unilateral-halter.name: one-arm dumbbell row
remada-unilateral-halter.start: left knee and left hand on the bench, right foot on the floor, back flat and parallel to the floor, a dumbbell in the right hand with the arm hanging straight
remada-unilateral-halter.end: pulls the dumbbell up toward the hip, elbow close to the body, then lowers it slowly
remada-unilateral-halter.checks: Costas retas paralelas ao chão, puxa o halter em direção ao quadril, sem girar o tronco

remada-halteres-banco-inclinado.name: chest-supported dumbbell row
remada-halteres-banco-inclinado.scene: an adjustable bench, inclined about 30 degrees
remada-halteres-banco-inclinado.start: lying face down on the incline bench, chest on the pad, feet on the floor, a dumbbell in each hand with the arms hanging straight down
remada-halteres-banco-inclinado.end: pulls both dumbbells up to the sides of the ribs, elbows close to the body
remada-halteres-banco-inclinado.checks: Peito apoiado no banco, cotovelos sobem rente ao corpo, volta controlada

remada-baixa-polia.name: seated cable row
remada-baixa-polia.scene: a seated low cable row station
remada-baixa-polia.start: seated at the low cable row, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, torso upright, holding the V-handle with arms extended forward
remada-baixa-polia.end: pulls the handle to the belly, elbows close to the body, chest up
remada-baixa-polia.checks: Tronco ereto, sem balançar para trás, puxa até o abdômen

remada-maquina.name: chest-supported machine row
remada-maquina.start: seated with the chest against the pad, holding the handles with arms extended forward
remada-maquina.end: pulls the handles back, elbows close to the body
remada-maquina.checks: Peito no apoio, ombros para trás no fim, volta controlada

remada-elastico.name: seated resistance band row
remada-elastico.start: seated on the floor, legs extended forward, a resistance band looped around the soles of the feet, a handle in each hand with arms extended, torso upright
remada-elastico.end: pulls both handles to the belly, elbows close to the body
remada-elastico.checks: Tronco ereto, cotovelos rente ao corpo, volta controlando o elástico

remada-kettlebell.name: bent-over kettlebell row
remada-kettlebell.start: standing in a staggered stance, left foot forward, left hand on the left thigh, hips back, torso leaning forward with a flat back, a kettlebell in the right hand with the arm hanging straight
remada-kettlebell.end: pulls the kettlebell up toward the hip with the right arm, then lowers it slowly
remada-kettlebell.checks: Coluna neutra, puxa até o quadril, sem girar o tronco

remada-invertida.name: inverted row
remada-invertida.scene: a barbell set at hip height on a rack
remada-invertida.start: hanging under the bar, gripping it with arms straight, body in one straight line, heels on the floor
remada-invertida.end: pulls the chest up to the bar, body straight
remada-invertida.checks: Corpo em linha reta, peito vai até a barra, sem quadril caído

pulldown-bracos-estendidos.name: straight-arm cable pulldown
pulldown-bracos-estendidos.scene: a cable station with a straight bar at the top
pulldown-bracos-estendidos.start: standing facing the cable, slightly hinged forward, holding the bar at head height with straight arms
pulldown-bracos-estendidos.end: pulls the bar down in an arc to the thighs, keeping the arms straight
pulldown-bracos-estendidos.checks: Braços estendidos o tempo todo, movimento vem do ombro, tronco fixo

pullover-halter.name: dumbbell pullover
pullover-halter.start: lying on his back on the bench, feet on the floor, holding one dumbbell with both hands above the chest, elbows slightly bent
pullover-halter.end: lowers the dumbbell slowly behind the head in an arc, elbows keeping the same bend
pullover-halter.checks: Cotovelos levemente flexionados e fixos, amplitude confortável para o ombro

encolhimento-halteres.name: dumbbell shrug
encolhimento-halteres.start: standing tall facing the camera, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, arms straight
encolhimento-halteres.end: lifts both shoulders straight up toward the ears
encolhimento-halteres.rule: The arms stay straight; only the shoulders move.
encolhimento-halteres.checks: Sobe os ombros na vertical, sem girar, braços relaxados

barra-fixa-assistida.name: assisted pull-up on an assisted pull-up machine
barra-fixa-assistida.scene: an assisted pull-up and dip machine with a knee pad
barra-fixa-assistida.start: kneeling on the assistance pad of the machine, hands gripping the top handles wider than the shoulders, arms straight overhead
barra-fixa-assistida.end: pulls the body up until the chin is above the handles, elbows driving down, knees staying on the pad
barra-fixa-assistida.checks: Joelhos no apoio, puxa até o queixo passar a barra, desce controlado até estender os braços

puxada-unilateral-polia.name: single-arm cable lat pulldown
puxada-unilateral-polia.scene: a high cable station with a single handle
puxada-unilateral-polia.start: kneeling on one knee facing the high cable station, torso upright, one hand holding the single handle overhead with the arm straight, the other hand on the hip
puxada-unilateral-polia.end: pulls the handle down to the side of the chest, the elbow driving down toward the hip, torso staying upright
puxada-unilateral-polia.rule: Only one arm works; the torso does not twist.
puxada-unilateral-polia.checks: Tronco firme sem girar, cotovelo desce em direção ao quadril, volta até estender o braço

remada-unilateral-polia.name: single-arm seated cable row
remada-unilateral-polia.scene: a low cable station with a single handle
remada-unilateral-polia.start: standing in a split stance facing the low cable station, torso slightly leaning forward and straight, one hand holding the single handle with the arm extended in front, the other hand on the hip
remada-unilateral-polia.end: pulls the handle to the side of the waist, elbow close to the body, shoulder blade squeezed back, torso still
remada-unilateral-polia.rule: Only one arm works; the torso does not twist.
remada-unilateral-polia.checks: Coluna neutra, cotovelo junto ao corpo, puxa até a cintura sem girar o tronco

encolhimento-barra.name: barbell shrug
encolhimento-barra.start: standing tall facing the camera, holding a barbell in front of the thighs with straight arms, hands shoulder-width apart, shoulders relaxed down
encolhimento-barra.end: lifts the shoulders straight up toward the ears as high as possible, arms staying straight
encolhimento-barra.rule: The arms stay straight; only the shoulders move up and down, no rolling.
encolhimento-barra.checks: Braços estendidos, sobe os ombros reto em direção às orelhas, sem girar

desenvolvimento-halteres.name: seated dumbbell shoulder press
desenvolvimento-halteres.start: seated on the upright bench facing the camera, back against the pad, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward, elbows under the wrists
desenvolvimento-halteres.end: presses both dumbbells straight overhead until the arms are extended
desenvolvimento-halteres.checks: Costas apoiadas, punhos acima dos cotovelos, sem arquear a lombar

desenvolvimento-barra.name: standing barbell overhead press
desenvolvimento-barra.start: standing facing the camera, feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell at the front of the shoulders, elbows slightly in front of the bar
desenvolvimento-barra.end: presses the bar straight overhead, moving the head slightly back to let it pass, until the arms are straight
desenvolvimento-barra.checks: Abdômen e glúteos firmes, sem arquear a lombar, barra sobe em linha reta

desenvolvimento-maquina.name: machine shoulder press
desenvolvimento-maquina.start: seated in the shoulder press machine facing the camera, back against the pad, hands on the handles at shoulder height
desenvolvimento-maquina.end: presses the handles overhead until the arms are almost straight
desenvolvimento-maquina.checks: Costas apoiadas, sem travar os cotovelos, descida controlada

desenvolvimento-arnold.name: Arnold press
desenvolvimento-arnold.start: seated on the upright bench facing the camera, dumbbells in front of the shoulders, palms facing his body, elbows in front
desenvolvimento-arnold.end: presses the dumbbells up while rotating the palms to face forward
desenvolvimento-arnold.checks: Rotação suave durante a subida, costas apoiadas, movimento controlado

desenvolvimento-elastico.name: resistance band shoulder press
desenvolvimento-elastico.start: standing facing the camera with both feet on the middle of a resistance band, a handle in each hand at shoulder height, palms forward
desenvolvimento-elastico.end: presses both handles straight overhead until the arms are extended
desenvolvimento-elastico.checks: Tronco firme, sem arquear a lombar

desenvolvimento-kettlebell.name: kettlebell overhead press
desenvolvimento-kettlebell.start: standing facing the camera, a kettlebell in the right hand resting at the right shoulder, the bell on the outside of the forearm
desenvolvimento-kettlebell.end: presses the kettlebell straight overhead with the right arm, then lowers it back to the shoulder
desenvolvimento-kettlebell.checks: Abdômen firme, punho reto, braço estende em cima da cabeça

flexao-pike.name: pike push-up
flexao-pike.start: in an inverted V on the floor: hands and feet on the floor, hips high, legs and arms straight, head between the arms
flexao-pike.end: bends the elbows to lower the top of the head toward the floor between the hands
flexao-pike.checks: Quadril alto, cabeça desce entre as mãos, cotovelos não abrem demais

elevacao-lateral-halteres.name: dumbbell lateral raise
elevacao-lateral-halteres.start: standing tall facing the camera, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, palms facing the body, elbows slightly bent
elevacao-lateral-halteres.end: raises both arms out to the sides until the hands reach shoulder height, elbows slightly bent
elevacao-lateral-halteres.rule: No swinging of the torso; the arms rise only to shoulder height.
elevacao-lateral-halteres.checks: Sobe até a altura do ombro, sem embalo, cotovelos levemente flexionados

elevacao-lateral-polia.name: cable lateral raise
elevacao-lateral-polia.scene: a cable station with a handle at the bottom
elevacao-lateral-polia.start: standing with the left side next to the low cable, holding the handle with the right hand in front of the left hip, cable crossing in front of the body
elevacao-lateral-polia.end: raises the right arm out to the side to shoulder height, elbow slightly bent, then lowers it slowly
elevacao-lateral-polia.checks: Sobe até a altura do ombro, tronco fixo, volta controlada

elevacao-lateral-elastico.name: resistance band lateral raise
elevacao-lateral-elastico.start: standing facing the camera with both feet on the middle of a resistance band, a handle in each hand at the sides
elevacao-lateral-elastico.end: raises both arms out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent
elevacao-lateral-elastico.checks: Sobe até a altura do ombro, sem encolher os ombros

elevacao-frontal-halteres.name: dumbbell front raise
elevacao-frontal-halteres.start: standing tall, a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, palms facing the thighs, arms straight
elevacao-frontal-halteres.end: raises both arms straight forward until the hands reach shoulder height
elevacao-frontal-halteres.checks: Sobe até a altura do ombro, sem jogar o tronco para trás

crucifixo-invertido-halteres.name: bent-over dumbbell reverse fly
crucifixo-invertido-halteres.start: standing with knees slightly bent, hinged forward at the hips with a flat back, torso almost parallel to the floor, dumbbells hanging below the chest, palms facing each other
crucifixo-invertido-halteres.end: raises both arms out to the sides, elbows slightly bent, squeezing the shoulder blades together
crucifixo-invertido-halteres.checks: Coluna neutra, cotovelos levemente flexionados, abre até a linha dos ombros

crucifixo-invertido-maquina.name: reverse pec deck
crucifixo-invertido-maquina.start: seated facing the pec deck pad, chest against it, arms extended forward holding the handles at shoulder height
crucifixo-invertido-maquina.end: opens both arms back to the sides until they line up with the shoulders
crucifixo-invertido-maquina.checks: Peito no apoio, abre até a linha dos ombros, sem encolher

face-pull.name: cable face pull
face-pull.scene: a cable station with a rope at face height
face-pull.start: standing facing the cable, holding both ends of the rope at face height with arms extended, palms facing each other
face-pull.end: pulls the rope toward the face, elbows high and wide, separating the rope ends beside the ears
face-pull.checks: Cotovelos altos, puxa em direção ao rosto, abre as mãos no fim

face-pull-elastico.name: resistance band face pull
face-pull-elastico.scene: a resistance band anchored at face height on the frame
face-pull-elastico.start: standing facing the anchor, holding the band with both hands at face height, arms extended
face-pull-elastico.end: pulls the band toward the face, elbows high and wide
face-pull-elastico.checks: Cotovelos altos, escápulas se aproximam, volta controlada

elevacao-lateral-maquina.name: machine lateral raise
elevacao-lateral-maquina.start: seated on the lateral raise machine facing the camera, chest against the pad, arms at the sides with the elbows against the arm pads
elevacao-lateral-maquina.end: raises both arms out to the sides until the elbows reach shoulder height
elevacao-lateral-maquina.checks: Sobe até a altura do ombro, tronco apoiado, volta controlada

crucifixo-invertido-polia.name: cable reverse fly
crucifixo-invertido-polia.scene: a dual cable crossover station with the pulleys at shoulder height
crucifixo-invertido-polia.start: standing in the middle of the cable station facing the camera, arms crossed in front of the chest at shoulder height, each hand holding the cable from the opposite side, elbows slightly bent
crucifixo-invertido-polia.end: opens both arms wide out to the sides at shoulder height until they form a T, elbows slightly bent
crucifixo-invertido-polia.checks: Braços na altura dos ombros, cotovelos levemente flexionados, aproxima as escápulas

abertura-elastico.name: resistance band pull-apart
abertura-elastico.start: standing tall facing the camera, holding a resistance band in front of the chest at shoulder height with both hands, arms straight
abertura-elastico.end: pulls the band apart by opening both straight arms out to the sides until the band touches the chest
abertura-elastico.rule: The arms stay straight and at shoulder height.
abertura-elastico.checks: Braços estendidos na altura dos ombros, aproxima as escápulas, sem subir os ombros

rotacao-externa-polia.name: cable shoulder external rotation
rotacao-externa-polia.scene: a cable station with a single handle at elbow height
rotacao-externa-polia.start: standing facing the camera with the cable station to his left, right elbow bent at 90 degrees and pinned to the side, right hand holding the handle in front of the belly
rotacao-externa-polia.end: rotates the right forearm outward away from the body, the elbow staying pinned to the side and bent at 90 degrees
rotacao-externa-polia.rule: The elbow stays glued to the side of the body; only the forearm swings outward like a door.
rotacao-externa-polia.checks: Cotovelo colado no corpo a 90°, só o antebraço gira para fora, carga leve

remada-alta-barra.name: barbell upright row
remada-alta-barra.start: standing tall facing the camera, holding a barbell in front of the thighs with straight arms, hands slightly wider than shoulder width
remada-alta-barra.end: pulls the bar straight up close to the body until it reaches the lower chest, elbows leading and rising out to the sides up to shoulder height
remada-alta-barra.rule: The elbows go no higher than the shoulders.
remada-alta-barra.checks: Pegada na largura dos ombros ou mais, barra sobe colada ao corpo, cotovelos no máximo na altura dos ombros

desenvolvimento-landmine.name: single-arm landmine press
desenvolvimento-landmine.scene: a barbell with one end anchored in a landmine attachment on the floor
desenvolvimento-landmine.start: standing in a split stance facing the anchored barbell, holding the free end of the bar with one hand at the front of the shoulder, elbow bent and pointing down
desenvolvimento-landmine.end: presses the bar up and forward until the arm is straight, the torso staying still and leaning slightly forward
desenvolvimento-landmine.rule: Only one arm presses; the torso does not twist or lean back.
desenvolvimento-landmine.checks: Tronco firme sem arquear a lombar, empurra para cima e à frente, volta controlado ao ombro

rosca-direta-barra.name: barbell biceps curl
rosca-direta-barra.start: standing tall, holding a barbell with an underhand grip at shoulder width, arms straight, bar in front of the thighs, elbows at the sides
rosca-direta-barra.end: curls the bar up to shoulder height, elbows staying at the sides
rosca-direta-barra.rule: The elbows and torso stay still; only the forearms move.
rosca-direta-barra.checks: Cotovelos colados ao corpo, sem balançar o tronco, desce até estender

rosca-alternada-halteres.name: alternating dumbbell curl
rosca-alternada-halteres.start: standing tall facing the camera, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, palms facing in, elbows at the sides
rosca-alternada-halteres.end: curls the right dumbbell up to the shoulder, turning the palm up, while the left arm stays down
rosca-alternada-halteres.rule: Only one arm moves at a time.
rosca-alternada-halteres.checks: Cotovelos fixos, sem embalo, alterna os braços

rosca-martelo.name: hammer curl
rosca-martelo.start: standing tall facing the camera, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, palms facing each other, elbows at the sides
rosca-martelo.end: curls both dumbbells up to the shoulders, palms still facing each other
rosca-martelo.checks: Pegada neutra o tempo todo, cotovelos fixos

rosca-scott.name: machine preacher curl
rosca-scott.start: seated at the preacher curl, upper arms resting on the angled pad, holding the handles with arms almost straight
rosca-scott.end: curls the handles up toward the shoulders, upper arms staying on the pad
rosca-scott.checks: Braços apoiados, desce sem estender totalmente de forma brusca

rosca-polia.name: cable biceps curl
rosca-polia.scene: a cable station with a straight bar at the bottom
rosca-polia.start: standing facing the low cable, holding the bar with an underhand grip, arms straight, elbows at the sides
rosca-polia.end: curls the bar up to shoulder height, elbows at the sides

rosca-concentrada.name: concentration curl
rosca-concentrada.start: seated on the end of the bench, legs apart, leaning forward, the back of the right upper arm braced against the inside of the right thigh, a dumbbell in the right hand with the arm straight
rosca-concentrada.end: curls the dumbbell up toward the shoulder with the right arm, then lowers it slowly
rosca-concentrada.checks: Cotovelo apoiado na coxa, só o antebraço se move

rosca-inclinada-halteres.name: incline dumbbell curl
rosca-inclinada-halteres.scene: an adjustable bench, inclined about 45 degrees
rosca-inclinada-halteres.start: lying back on the incline bench, arms hanging straight down behind the torso, a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward
rosca-inclinada-halteres.end: curls both dumbbells up toward the shoulders, upper arms staying vertical
rosca-inclinada-halteres.checks: Braços pendurados atrás do tronco, cotovelos fixos

rosca-elastico.name: resistance band curl
rosca-elastico.start: standing facing the camera with both feet on the middle of a resistance band, a handle in each hand, arms straight, palms forward
rosca-elastico.end: curls both handles up to the shoulders, elbows at the sides
rosca-elastico.checks: Cotovelos fixos, volta controlando o elástico

rosca-kettlebell.name: kettlebell curl
rosca-kettlebell.start: standing facing the camera, holding a kettlebell by the horns with both hands, arms straight, elbows at the sides
rosca-kettlebell.end: curls the kettlebell up to chest height
rosca-kettlebell.checks: Cotovelos colados ao corpo, sem embalo

rosca-direta-halteres.name: standing dumbbell biceps curl
rosca-direta-halteres.start: standing tall facing the camera, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, palms facing forward, elbows at the sides
rosca-direta-halteres.end: curls both dumbbells up to the shoulders at the same time, elbows staying at the sides
rosca-direta-halteres.rule: The elbows and torso stay still; only the forearms move.
rosca-direta-halteres.checks: Cotovelos fixos ao lado do corpo, sem embalo do tronco, sobe os dois juntos

rosca-barra-w.name: EZ-bar biceps curl
rosca-barra-w.scene: an EZ curl bar (the zigzag-shaped bar) on a rack
rosca-barra-w.start: standing tall, holding the EZ curl bar on its angled grips in front of the thighs with straight arms, palms angled forward, elbows at the sides
rosca-barra-w.end: curls the bar up to the upper chest, elbows staying at the sides
rosca-barra-w.rule: The elbows and torso stay still; only the forearms move.
rosca-barra-w.checks: Cotovelos fixos, sem embalo do tronco, punhos firmes

rosca-scott-barra.name: EZ-bar preacher curl
rosca-scott-barra.scene: a preacher curl bench and an EZ curl bar (the zigzag-shaped bar)
rosca-scott-barra.start: seated at the preacher curl bench, the back of the upper arms resting on the angled pad, holding the EZ curl bar with the arms almost straight
rosca-scott-barra.end: curls the bar up toward the shoulders, the upper arms staying on the pad
rosca-scott-barra.rule: The upper arms never leave the pad.
rosca-scott-barra.checks: Braço todo apoiado no banco Scott, não estende totalmente embaixo, volta controlada

triceps-polia-barra.name: cable triceps pushdown with bar
triceps-polia-barra.scene: a cable station with a straight bar at the top
triceps-polia-barra.start: standing facing the high cable, elbows tucked at the sides, holding the bar at chest height with an overhand grip
triceps-polia-barra.end: pushes the bar down until the arms are straight against the thighs, elbows fixed at the sides
triceps-polia-barra.rule: The elbows stay pinned at the sides; only the forearms move.
triceps-polia-barra.checks: Cotovelos colados ao corpo e fixos, só o antebraço se move

triceps-corda.name: cable rope triceps pushdown
triceps-corda.scene: a cable station with a rope at the top
triceps-corda.start: standing facing the high cable, elbows tucked at the sides, holding the rope ends at chest height
triceps-corda.end: pushes the rope down and separates the ends beside the thighs, arms straight
triceps-corda.rule: The elbows stay pinned at the sides; only the forearms move.
triceps-corda.checks: Cotovelos fixos, abre a corda no fim, volta controlada

triceps-testa.name: barbell skull crusher
triceps-testa.start: lying on his back on the bench, holding a barbell with an overhand grip, arms straight above the chest
triceps-testa.end: bends only the elbows to lower the bar slowly toward the forehead, upper arms still
triceps-testa.checks: Cotovelos apontados para cima e fixos, descida lenta

triceps-frances-halter.name: overhead dumbbell triceps extension
triceps-frances-halter.start: standing tall, holding one dumbbell with both hands under the top plate, arms straight overhead
triceps-frances-halter.end: bends the elbows to lower the dumbbell behind the head, elbows pointing up
triceps-frances-halter.checks: Cotovelos apontados para frente/cima, abdômen firme, sem arquear a lombar

triceps-coice.name: dumbbell triceps kickback
triceps-coice.start: left knee and left hand on the bench, back flat, right upper arm parallel to the floor and close to the body, elbow bent at 90 degrees, a dumbbell in the right hand
triceps-coice.end: extends the right elbow back until the arm is straight, then bends it back slowly
triceps-coice.checks: Braço fixo paralelo ao chão, só o antebraço se move

triceps-elastico.name: resistance band triceps pushdown
triceps-elastico.scene: a resistance band anchored high on the frame
triceps-elastico.start: standing facing the anchor, elbows tucked at the sides, holding the band at chest height
triceps-elastico.end: pushes the band down until the arms are straight, elbows fixed
triceps-elastico.checks: Cotovelos fixos ao lado do corpo

mergulho-banco.name: bench dip
mergulho-banco.start: hands on the edge of the bench behind him, fingers forward, legs extended with heels on the floor, arms straight, hips just in front of the bench
mergulho-banco.end: bends the elbows to lower the hips toward the floor until the elbows reach about 90 degrees
mergulho-banco.checks: Desce até ~90° de cotovelo, costas perto do banco, ombros longe das orelhas

supino-fechado.name: close-grip barbell bench press
supino-fechado.scene: a flat bench with a loaded barbell on a rack
supino-fechado.start: lying on the bench, feet on the floor, gripping the barbell at shoulder width, arms straight above the chest
supino-fechado.end: lowers the bar to the lower chest, elbows close to the body
supino-fechado.checks: Pegada na largura dos ombros, cotovelos rente ao corpo, punhos retos

flexao-diamante.name: diamond push-up
flexao-diamante.start: in a high plank on the floor, hands together under the chest with thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond, body straight
flexao-diamante.end: lowers the chest to the hands, elbows close to the body
flexao-diamante.checks: Corpo alinhado, cotovelos rente ao corpo

triceps-unilateral-polia.name: single-arm cable triceps pushdown
triceps-unilateral-polia.scene: a high cable station with a single handle
triceps-unilateral-polia.start: standing tall facing the high cable station, one hand holding the single handle at chest height, elbow bent and pinned to the side
triceps-unilateral-polia.end: pushes the handle down until the arm is straight beside the thigh, the elbow staying pinned to the side
triceps-unilateral-polia.rule: The elbow stays pinned at the side; only the forearm moves.
triceps-unilateral-polia.checks: Cotovelo colado ao corpo, estende todo o braço, volta até ~90° sem subir o cotovelo

triceps-frances-polia.name: overhead cable triceps extension with a rope
triceps-frances-polia.scene: a cable station with a rope attached to the low pulley
triceps-frances-polia.start: standing in a split stance facing away from the low cable station, holding the rope behind the head with both hands, elbows bent and pointing up beside the head
triceps-frances-polia.end: extends both arms straight up overhead, the elbows staying close to the head
triceps-frances-polia.rule: The elbows stay pointing up next to the head; only the forearms move.
triceps-frances-polia.checks: Cotovelos apontados para cima perto da cabeça, abdômen firme, estende todo o braço

mergulho-maquina.name: seated machine triceps dip
mergulho-maquina.start: seated on the dip machine, back against the pad, hands on the handles beside the ribs, elbows bent behind him
mergulho-maquina.end: pushes the handles down until the arms are straight beside the body
mergulho-maquina.checks: Costas apoiadas, cotovelos apontando para trás, estende sem travar

rosca-punho.name: dumbbell wrist curl
rosca-punho.start: seated on the bench, forearms resting on the thighs, wrists just past the knees, palms up holding a light dumbbell in each hand
rosca-punho.rule: The forearms stay on the thighs; only the wrists move.
rosca-punho.checks: Antebraço apoiado, só o punho se move, carga leve

caminhada-fazendeiro.name: farmer walk
caminhada-fazendeiro.start: standing tall, a heavy dumbbell in each hand at the sides, shoulders back
caminhada-fazendeiro.end: walks slowly forward with short, firm steps, upright posture, arms straight
caminhada-fazendeiro.checks: Postura ereta, ombros para trás, passos curtos e firmes

rosca-inversa.name: reverse-grip barbell curl
rosca-inversa.start: standing tall, holding a barbell in front of the thighs with an overhand grip (palms facing back), arms straight, elbows at the sides
rosca-inversa.end: curls the bar up to the upper chest keeping the overhand grip, elbows staying at the sides
rosca-inversa.rule: Palms face down the whole time; the elbows stay at the sides.
rosca-inversa.checks: Pegada pronada (palmas para baixo), cotovelos fixos, punhos retos

suspensao-barra.name: dead hang from a pull-up bar
suspensao-barra.start: standing under the pull-up bar reaching up and gripping it with both hands shoulder-width apart, feet still on the floor
suspensao-barra.end: hangs from the bar with straight arms and feet off the floor, body still and vertical, shoulders active
suspensao-barra.rule: No swinging; he just hangs still.
suspensao-barra.checks: Braços estendidos, corpo parado sem balançar, segura o tempo indicado

agachamento-livre.name: barbell back squat
agachamento-livre.scene: a squat rack with a loaded barbell
agachamento-livre.start: standing with the barbell resting on the upper back, hands gripping it outside the shoulders, feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out
agachamento-livre.end: pushes the hips back and bends the knees, lowering until the thighs are about parallel to the floor, chest up, heels down
agachamento-livre.checks: Coluna neutra, joelhos na direção dos pés, calcanhares no chão, desce até ~paralelo

agachamento-frontal.name: barbell front squat
agachamento-frontal.scene: a squat rack with a loaded barbell
agachamento-frontal.start: standing with the barbell resting on the front of the shoulders, elbows high and pointing forward, feet shoulder-width apart
agachamento-frontal.end: squats down keeping the torso upright and elbows high, until the thighs are about parallel
agachamento-frontal.checks: Cotovelos altos, tronco ereto, joelhos na direção dos pés

agachamento-smith.name: Smith machine squat
agachamento-smith.start: standing under the Smith machine bar resting on the upper back, feet slightly in front of the body, shoulder-width apart
agachamento-smith.end: squats down until the thighs are about parallel to the floor
agachamento-smith.checks: Pés levemente à frente, joelhos na direção dos pés, coluna neutra

agachamento-goblet.name: goblet squat
agachamento-goblet.start: standing tall facing the camera, feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell vertically against the chest with both hands
agachamento-goblet.end: pushes the hips back and bends the knees, lowering until the thighs are about parallel to the floor, chest up, dumbbell against the chest
agachamento-goblet.checks: Halter junto ao peito, joelhos na direção dos pés, calcanhares no chão, costas retas

agachamento-goblet-kettlebell.name: kettlebell goblet squat
agachamento-goblet-kettlebell.start: standing tall facing the camera, feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell by the horns against the chest
agachamento-goblet-kettlebell.end: squats down until the thighs are about parallel, chest up, kettlebell against the chest
agachamento-goblet-kettlebell.checks: Kettlebell junto ao peito, joelhos na direção dos pés, calcanhares no chão

agachamento-peso-corpo.name: bodyweight squat
agachamento-peso-corpo.start: standing tall, feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended forward at shoulder height
agachamento-peso-corpo.end: pushes the hips back and bends the knees, lowering until the thighs are about parallel to the floor, heels down
agachamento-peso-corpo.checks: Joelhos na direção dos pés, calcanhares no chão, peito aberto

agachamento-elastico.name: resistance band squat
agachamento-elastico.start: standing facing the camera with both feet on a resistance band, holding the handles at the shoulders
agachamento-elastico.end: squats down until the thighs are about parallel
agachamento-elastico.checks: Joelhos na direção dos pés, tronco firme

agachamento-sumo-halter.name: dumbbell sumo squat
agachamento-sumo-halter.start: standing facing the camera with a wide stance, toes turned out, holding one dumbbell vertically with both hands between the legs
agachamento-sumo-halter.end: squats straight down, knees opening in line with the toes, torso upright
agachamento-sumo-halter.checks: Base larga, joelhos abrem na direção dos pés, tronco ereto

leg-press.name: 45-degree leg press
leg-press.start: seated in the leg press, back and hips against the seat, feet shoulder-width on the platform, legs nearly straight
leg-press.end: bends the knees to lower the platform until the knees reach about 90 degrees
leg-press.checks: Lombar apoiada no encosto, joelhos na direção dos pés, sem travar os joelhos

agachamento-hack.name: hack squat machine
agachamento-hack.start: standing in the hack squat machine, back against the pad, shoulders under the pads, feet shoulder-width on the platform
agachamento-hack.end: squats down until the thighs are about parallel
agachamento-hack.checks: Costas no encosto, joelhos na direção dos pés, descida controlada

afundo-halteres.name: dumbbell lunge
afundo-halteres.start: standing tall, feet together, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides
afundo-halteres.end: steps forward with the right leg and lowers until both knees are at about 90 degrees, the back knee near the floor, then pushes back to standing
afundo-halteres.checks: Tronco ereto, joelho da frente sobre o pé, joelho de trás quase toca o chão

afundo-peso-corpo.name: bodyweight lunge
afundo-peso-corpo.start: standing tall, feet together, hands on the hips
afundo-peso-corpo.end: steps forward with the right leg and lowers until both knees are at about 90 degrees, then pushes back to standing
afundo-peso-corpo.checks: Tronco ereto, joelho da frente alinhado ao pé

avanco-caminhando.name: walking dumbbell lunge
avanco-caminhando.start: standing tall, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides
avanco-caminhando.end: steps forward with the right leg into a lunge, back knee near the floor
avanco-caminhando.checks: Passos longos, tronco ereto, joelho de trás desce perto do chão

agachamento-bulgaro.name: Bulgarian split squat
agachamento-bulgaro.start: standing about one big step in front of the bench, the top of the left foot resting on the bench behind him, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides
agachamento-bulgaro.end: lowers straight down on the right leg until the right thigh is about parallel to the floor, then stands up
agachamento-bulgaro.checks: Joelho da frente alinhado ao pé, tronco levemente inclinado, descida controlada

subida-banco.name: dumbbell step-up
subida-banco.start: standing in front of the bench, a dumbbell in each hand, right foot flat on the bench
subida-banco.end: steps up onto the bench pushing through the right foot, then steps back down with control
subida-banco.checks: Sobe empurrando com a perna de cima, joelho alinhado ao pé

cadeira-extensora.name: leg extension machine
cadeira-extensora.start: seated in the leg extension machine, back against the pad, ankles behind the lower pad, knees bent at 90 degrees
cadeira-extensora.end: extends both knees until the legs are straight
cadeira-extensora.checks: Costas apoiadas, sobe sem tranco, desce devagar

agachamento-dividido-halteres.name: dumbbell split squat
agachamento-dividido-halteres.start: standing in a long split stance, one foot forward and the other back on the toes, torso upright, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides
agachamento-dividido-halteres.end: lowers straight down until the back knee almost touches the floor and the front thigh is parallel to the floor, the feet staying in place
agachamento-dividido-halteres.rule: The feet do not move; the body goes straight down and up.
agachamento-dividido-halteres.checks: Tronco ereto, joelho da frente alinhado ao pé, joelho de trás quase toca o chão, pés parados

afundo-reverso.name: bodyweight reverse lunge
afundo-reverso.start: standing tall with feet hip-width apart, hands on the hips
afundo-reverso.end: steps one foot back and lowers until the back knee almost touches the floor and the front thigh is parallel to the floor, torso upright
afundo-reverso.checks: Passo para trás, tronco ereto, joelho da frente alinhado ao pé, volta empurrando com a perna da frente

afundo-lateral.name: bodyweight lateral lunge
afundo-lateral.start: standing tall facing the camera, feet together, hands clasped in front of the chest
afundo-lateral.end: takes a wide step to the right and sits the hips back over the right foot, right knee bent over the right foot, left leg straight, both feet flat
afundo-lateral.checks: Quadril vai para trás, joelho alinhado ao pé, perna de apoio estendida, pés no chão

agachamento-parede.name: wall sit
agachamento-parede.start: standing with the back against the wall, feet about two feet in front of the wall, arms at the sides
agachamento-parede.end: slides down the wall until the thighs are parallel to the floor and the knees are bent at 90 degrees over the ankles, back flat on the wall, holding still
agachamento-parede.checks: Costas na parede, joelhos a 90° sobre os tornozelos, segura o tempo indicado

cadeira-adutora.name: hip adduction machine
cadeira-adutora.start: seated in the adductor machine facing the camera, back against the pad, legs open with the inner thighs against the pads
cadeira-adutora.end: squeezes both legs together until the pads meet

cadeira-abdutora.name: hip abduction machine
cadeira-abdutora.start: seated in the abductor machine facing the camera, back against the pad, legs together with the outer thighs against the pads
cadeira-abdutora.end: pushes both legs apart as far as comfortable

levantamento-terra.name: barbell deadlift
levantamento-terra.scene: a loaded barbell on the floor
levantamento-terra.start: standing with the barbell over the middle of the feet, hips hinged and knees bent, back flat, arms straight gripping the bar just outside the legs
levantamento-terra.end: lifts the bar by pushing the floor away and extending hips and knees together, the bar sliding close to the legs, until standing tall
levantamento-terra.rule: The back stays flat the whole time, never rounded.
levantamento-terra.checks: Coluna neutra o tempo todo, barra rente às pernas, sobe com quadril e joelhos juntos

stiff-barra.name: barbell Romanian deadlift
stiff-barra.start: standing tall holding a barbell in front of the thighs, overhand grip, knees slightly bent
stiff-barra.end: pushes the hips back, lowering the bar along the legs to just below the knees, back flat, knees keeping the same slight bend
stiff-barra.rule: The back stays flat the whole time, never rounded.
stiff-barra.checks: Joelhos levemente flexionados e fixos, coluna neutra, barra rente às pernas

stiff-halteres.name: dumbbell Romanian deadlift
stiff-halteres.start: standing tall, a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, knees slightly bent
stiff-halteres.end: pushes the hips back, lowering the dumbbells along the legs to just below the knees, back flat
stiff-halteres.rule: The back stays flat the whole time, never rounded.
stiff-halteres.checks: Coluna neutra, quadril vai para trás, joelhos levemente flexionados

stiff-unilateral.name: single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift
stiff-unilateral.start: standing on the left leg, a dumbbell in the right hand, right foot just off the floor
stiff-unilateral.end: hinges forward on the left leg while the right leg extends straight back, until the torso and right leg form a line parallel to the floor, then returns to standing
stiff-unilateral.checks: Quadril nivelado, coluna neutra, equilíbrio controlado

stiff-kettlebell.name: kettlebell Romanian deadlift
stiff-kettlebell.start: standing tall, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of the thighs, knees slightly bent
stiff-kettlebell.end: pushes the hips back, lowering the kettlebell along the legs to just below the knees, back flat
stiff-kettlebell.checks: Coluna neutra, quadril para trás, joelhos levemente flexionados

swing-kettlebell.name: kettlebell swing
swing-kettlebell.start: standing with feet wider than the shoulders, hips hinged back, back flat, holding a kettlebell with both hands between the legs
swing-kettlebell.end: snaps the hips forward to stand tall, the straight arms letting the kettlebell float up to chest height
swing-kettlebell.rule: This is a hip hinge, not a squat: the arms stay straight and do not lift the weight.
swing-kettlebell.checks: Movimento vem do quadril (não dos braços), coluna neutra, glúteos contraem no topo

elevacao-pelvica-barra.name: barbell hip thrust
elevacao-pelvica-barra.scene: an adjustable bench, flat, with a padded barbell on the floor in front of it
elevacao-pelvica-barra.start: seated on the floor with the upper back against the side of the bench, knees bent, feet flat, a padded barbell resting across the hips, hands holding the bar
elevacao-pelvica-barra.end: drives the hips up until the body is straight from shoulders to knees, chin slightly tucked
elevacao-pelvica-barra.checks: Queixo levemente para baixo, sobe até alinhar o tronco, sem arquear a lombar

elevacao-pelvica-halter.name: dumbbell hip thrust
elevacao-pelvica-halter.start: seated on the floor with the upper back against the side of the bench, knees bent, feet flat, a dumbbell held on the hips
elevacao-pelvica-halter.end: drives the hips up until the body is straight from shoulders to knees
elevacao-pelvica-halter.checks: Sobe até alinhar o tronco, contrai os glúteos no topo

ponte-gluteo.name: glute bridge
ponte-gluteo.start: lying on his back on the floor, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, arms on the floor by the sides
ponte-gluteo.end: lifts the hips until the body is straight from shoulders to knees
ponte-gluteo.checks: Sobe contraindo os glúteos, sem arquear a lombar

ponte-gluteo-unilateral.name: single-leg glute bridge
ponte-gluteo-unilateral.start: lying on his back on the floor, left knee bent with the foot flat, right leg extended straight in the air in line with the left thigh
ponte-gluteo-unilateral.end: lifts the hips by pushing through the left foot until the body is straight, then lowers
ponte-gluteo-unilateral.checks: Quadril nivelado, sobe com o glúteo da perna apoiada

hiperextensao.name: back extension on a Roman chair
hiperextensao.start: on the 45-degree bench, hips on the pad, heels under the foot pads, body in a straight line, arms crossed on the chest
hiperextensao.end: bends at the hips to lower the torso slowly toward the floor, back flat
hiperextensao.checks: Sobe só até alinhar o corpo (sem hiperestender), movimento lento

mesa-flexora.name: lying leg curl machine
mesa-flexora.start: lying face down on the leg curl machine, hips on the pad, ankles under the roller, legs straight, holding the handles
mesa-flexora.end: curls the heels toward the glutes
mesa-flexora.checks: Quadril apoiado no banco, sobe sem tranco, desce devagar

cadeira-flexora.name: seated leg curl machine
cadeira-flexora.start: seated in the leg curl machine, back against the pad, legs straight with the ankles on top of the lower roller
cadeira-flexora.end: bends the knees pulling the roller down and back under the seat

bom-dia-barra.name: barbell good morning
bom-dia-barra.scene: a squat rack with a barbell
bom-dia-barra.start: standing tall with a barbell resting on the upper back, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, back flat
bom-dia-barra.end: hinges at the hips pushing them back, torso lowering until it is almost parallel to the floor, back flat, knees slightly bent
bom-dia-barra.rule: This is a hip hinge: the back stays flat and the knees only slightly bent.
bom-dia-barra.checks: Coluna neutra, quadril vai para trás, joelhos levemente flexionados, carga leve

gluteo-polia.name: cable glute kickback
gluteo-polia.scene: a cable station with an ankle strap at the bottom
gluteo-polia.start: standing facing the cable, holding the frame, ankle strap on the right ankle, torso slightly leaning forward
gluteo-polia.end: kicks the right leg straight back extending the hip, then returns slowly
gluteo-polia.checks: Tronco fixo, sem arquear a lombar, movimento vem do quadril

gluteo-quatro-apoios.name: quadruped glute kickback
gluteo-quatro-apoios.start: on hands and knees on the floor, hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips, back flat
gluteo-quatro-apoios.end: lifts the right leg, knee bent at 90 degrees, until the thigh is parallel to the floor, then lowers it
gluteo-quatro-apoios.checks: Coluna neutra, sem girar o quadril, sobe até a linha do tronco

abducao-elastico.name: resistance band hip abduction
abducao-elastico.start: standing tall facing the camera, hands on the hips, a mini band around both thighs above the knees
abducao-elastico.end: lifts the right leg out to the side against the band, then returns
abducao-elastico.checks: Tronco ereto, quadril nivelado, volta controlando o elástico

levantamento-terra-sumo.name: sumo deadlift
levantamento-terra-sumo.scene: a loaded barbell on the floor
levantamento-terra-sumo.start: standing in a very wide stance with toes turned out, shins close to the barbell on the floor, hips down, chest up, back flat, arms straight gripping the bar between the legs
levantamento-terra-sumo.end: stands up tall by pushing the floor away, hips and knees extending together, the bar staying close to the legs until he is fully upright
levantamento-terra-sumo.rule: The back stays flat the whole time, never rounded.
levantamento-terra-sumo.checks: Base bem aberta com pés para fora, coluna neutra, barra colada ao corpo, joelhos acompanham os pés

elevacao-pelvica-maquina.name: machine hip thrust
elevacao-pelvica-maquina.start: seated in the hip thrust machine, upper back against the back pad, the padded belt across the hips, feet flat on the platform, hips low
elevacao-pelvica-maquina.end: drives the hips up until the body is straight from the shoulders to the knees, knees bent at 90 degrees, squeezing the glutes
elevacao-pelvica-maquina.checks: Queixo para baixo, sobe até alinhar ombros, quadril e joelhos, sem arquear a lombar

pull-through-polia.name: cable pull-through
pull-through-polia.scene: a cable station with a rope attached to the low pulley
pull-through-polia.start: standing facing away from the low cable station, feet wider than the hips, hinged forward at the hips with a flat back, holding the rope between the legs with straight arms
pull-through-polia.end: drives the hips forward and stands up tall, squeezing the glutes, arms straight with the rope in front of the hips
pull-through-polia.rule: The arms stay straight; the hips do the work.
pull-through-polia.checks: Movimento vem do quadril, coluna neutra, braços estendidos, sem puxar com os braços

coice-gluteo-maquina.name: glute kickback machine
coice-gluteo-maquina.start: positioned on the glute kickback machine with the torso supported on the chest pad, hands on the handles, one foot on the kick plate with the knee bent under the hip
coice-gluteo-maquina.end: pushes the plate back with one leg until the hip is fully extended, the back staying flat
coice-gluteo-maquina.rule: The lower back does not arch; only the hip moves.
coice-gluteo-maquina.checks: Lombar neutra, estende o quadril sem arquear, volta controlada

abducao-polia.name: standing cable hip abduction
abducao-polia.scene: a cable station with an ankle strap on the low pulley
abducao-polia.start: standing facing the camera with the low cable station to his left, one hand on the frame, the ankle strap on the right ankle, feet together
abducao-polia.end: lifts the right leg straight out to the side against the cable, torso upright, toes pointing forward
abducao-polia.rule: The torso stays upright and does not lean to the side.
abducao-polia.checks: Tronco ereto, perna sobe para o lado sem girar o pé, volta controlada

abducao-quatro-apoios.name: fire hydrant
abducao-quatro-apoios.start: on hands and knees facing the camera, hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips, back flat
abducao-quatro-apoios.end: lifts one bent knee out to the side until the thigh is almost parallel to the floor, keeping the knee bent at 90 degrees and the back flat
abducao-quatro-apoios.rule: The torso does not tilt; only the leg moves.
abducao-quatro-apoios.checks: Costas retas, joelho dobrado a 90°, abre a perna para o lado sem inclinar o tronco

ostra.name: clamshell
ostra.start: lying on his side on the floor facing the camera, head resting on the lower arm, hips and knees bent at about 45 degrees, knees and feet stacked
ostra.end: opens the top knee upward like a clamshell while the feet stay together, hips not rolling back
ostra.rule: The feet stay together and the hips do not roll back.
ostra.checks: Pés juntos, quadril parado sem rolar para trás, abre o joelho de cima

caminhada-lateral-elastico.name: lateral band walk
caminhada-lateral-elastico.start: standing facing the camera in a quarter squat, a mini resistance band around both legs just above the knees, feet hip-width apart, hands on the hips
caminhada-lateral-elastico.end: steps wide to the side with one foot, keeping the band taut and the quarter squat, knees pushed out
caminhada-lateral-elastico.checks: Meio agachamento o tempo todo, joelhos para fora, elástico sempre esticado

panturrilha-em-pe-maquina.name: standing calf raise machine
panturrilha-em-pe-maquina.start: standing in the calf raise machine, shoulders under the pads, balls of the feet on the step, heels lowered below the step, knees straight
panturrilha-em-pe-maquina.end: rises onto the toes as high as possible
panturrilha-em-pe-maquina.checks: Amplitude completa, pausa no topo, joelhos estendidos

panturrilha-sentado.name: seated calf raise machine
panturrilha-sentado.start: seated in the calf raise machine, knees under the pad, balls of the feet on the step, heels low
panturrilha-sentado.end: raises the heels as high as possible

panturrilha-leg-press.name: leg press calf raise
panturrilha-leg-press.start: seated in the leg press, legs straight but not locked, only the balls of the feet on the bottom edge of the platform
panturrilha-leg-press.end: pushes the platform by pointing the toes, ankles extending
panturrilha-leg-press.rule: The knees stay straight; only the ankles move.

panturrilha-halter.name: standing dumbbell calf raise
panturrilha-halter.start: standing tall, a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, feet hip-width apart
panturrilha-halter.end: rises onto the toes as high as possible
panturrilha-halter.checks: Sobe o máximo, desce devagar, tronco ereto

panturrilha-peso-corpo.name: bodyweight calf raise
panturrilha-peso-corpo.start: standing tall, hands on the hips, feet hip-width apart
panturrilha-peso-corpo.end: rises onto the toes as high as possible

prancha.name: forearm plank
prancha.start: in a forearm plank on the floor, elbows under the shoulders, forearms parallel, body in one straight line from head to heels
prancha.end: holds the position completely steady, breathing calmly, with only subtle breathing movement
prancha.rule: He does not move from the position: no push-ups, no hip movement.
prancha.checks: Corpo alinhado, abdômen e glúteos contraídos, sem quadril caído

prancha-lateral.name: side plank
prancha-lateral.start: in a side plank facing the camera, on the right forearm with the elbow under the shoulder, feet stacked, hips lifted, body in one straight line, left hand on the hip
prancha-lateral.end: holds the position steady for a moment
prancha-lateral.checks: Quadril alto, corpo em linha reta, cotovelo sob o ombro

abdominal-supra.name: crunch
abdominal-supra.start: lying on his back on the floor, knees bent, feet flat, fingertips lightly behind the ears, elbows wide
abdominal-supra.end: curls the head and shoulder blades off the floor, bringing the ribs toward the pelvis, lower back on the floor
abdominal-supra.rule: He does not sit all the way up; only the shoulder blades lift.
abdominal-supra.checks: Não puxa o pescoço, sobe só as escápulas, movimento curto

elevacao-pernas-deitado.name: lying leg raise
elevacao-pernas-deitado.start: lying on his back on the floor, legs straight together, hands flat under the hips, heels just above the floor
elevacao-pernas-deitado.end: raises both straight legs together until they point at the ceiling
elevacao-pernas-deitado.checks: Lombar encostada no chão, descida lenta

abdominal-bicicleta.name: bicycle crunch
abdominal-bicicleta.start: lying on his back on the floor, head and shoulders slightly lifted, fingertips lightly behind the ears, elbows wide, both knees bent at 90 degrees above the hips, lower back pressed to the floor
abdominal-bicicleta.end: his RIGHT leg extends straight out low above the floor while his LEFT knee pulls in toward the chest; at the same time he rotates the shoulders so the RIGHT elbow moves toward the LEFT knee
abdominal-bicicleta.rule: The legs move in opposite directions like pedaling, never together and never to the same side. The hips stay still; only the shoulders rotate.
abdominal-bicicleta.checks: Movimento controlado, sem puxar o pescoço

dead-bug.name: dead bug
dead-bug.start: lying on his back on the floor, arms pointing straight up at the ceiling, knees bent at 90 degrees above the hips, lower back pressed to the floor
dead-bug.end: lowers the RIGHT arm back over the head toward the floor while the LEFT leg extends straight out low above the floor, then brings both back to the start
dead-bug.rule: Always the opposite arm and leg together; the other arm and leg stay still.
dead-bug.checks: Lombar colada no chão, movimento lento

perdigueiro.name: bird dog
perdigueiro.start: on hands and knees on the floor, hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips, back flat
perdigueiro.end: extends the RIGHT arm straight forward and the LEFT leg straight back at the same time, both parallel to the floor, holds briefly, then returns
perdigueiro.rule: Always the opposite arm and leg together; the hips stay level.
perdigueiro.checks: Coluna neutra, quadril nivelado, sem girar o tronco

escalador.name: mountain climber
escalador.start: in a high plank on the floor, hands under the shoulders, arms straight, body straight
escalador.end: drives the RIGHT knee toward the chest, then returns the foot back
escalador.rule: The legs alternate one at a time; the hips stay low and the hands stay planted.
escalador.checks: Quadril baixo, mãos sob os ombros, ritmo constante

elevacao-pernas-barra.name: hanging leg raise
elevacao-pernas-barra.start: hanging from the pull-up bar with straight arms, legs straight and together, body still
elevacao-pernas-barra.end: raises both straight legs together in front until they reach hip height

abdominal-polia.name: kneeling cable crunch
abdominal-polia.scene: a tall cable station with the weight stack on the right side of the frame, fully visible, with a rope attached to its high pulley
abdominal-polia.start: kneeling on both knees on the left side of the frame, FACING RIGHT toward the cable station, about one arm length from it, thighs vertical, torso leaning FORWARD toward the machine about 45 degrees; both hands hold the rope ends beside his head at the ears, elbows bent and pointing down; the cable comes down from the high pulley in front of him to his hands
abdominal-polia.end: curls forward and down: the ribs move toward the pelvis, the upper and middle back round, the elbows go down toward the knees and the head moves down toward the floor in front of the knees; the hips stay in place above the knees
abdominal-polia.rule: He always faces the machine and leans toward it; he never leans backward or sits on his heels. The hips do not move: the movement is the spine curling, not a hip hinge. The hands stay beside the head the whole time; the arms do not pull.
abdominal-polia.checks: Costelas em direção à pelve, quadril parado, as mãos só seguram a corda (não puxa com os braços), volta controlada sem soltar o peso

pallof-polia.name: cable Pallof press
pallof-polia.scene: a cable station with a handle at chest height
pallof-polia.start: standing facing the camera with the cable to his right side, feet shoulder-width apart, holding the handle at the chest with both hands
pallof-polia.end: presses the handle straight forward until the arms are extended, torso not rotating
pallof-polia.rule: The torso never rotates toward the cable.
pallof-polia.checks: Tronco não gira, abdômen firme, braços estendem na frente do peito

pallof-elastico.name: resistance band Pallof press
pallof-elastico.scene: a resistance band anchored at chest height on the frame to his side
pallof-elastico.start: standing facing the camera with the band anchored to his right side, holding it at the chest with both hands
pallof-elastico.end: presses the band straight forward until the arms are extended, torso not rotating
pallof-elastico.rule: The torso never rotates toward the anchor.

abdominal-reverso.name: reverse crunch
abdominal-reverso.start: lying on his back on the floor, arms by the sides with palms down, knees bent at 90 degrees above the hips
abdominal-reverso.end: curls the hips off the floor bringing the knees toward the chest, lower back rolling up, shoulders staying on the floor
abdominal-reverso.rule: The knees move toward the chest; the legs do not swing.
abdominal-reverso.checks: Enrola o quadril para cima, sem embalo das pernas, desce devagar

abdominal-maquina.name: seated machine crunch
abdominal-maquina.start: seated in the ab crunch machine, feet hooked under the pads, hands holding the handles beside the head, torso upright
abdominal-maquina.end: curls the torso forward and down, ribs moving toward the pelvis, upper back rounding
abdominal-maquina.rule: The arms only hold; the abdomen does the work.
abdominal-maquina.checks: Costelas em direção à pelve, não puxa com os braços, volta controlada

hollow-body.name: hollow body hold
hollow-body.start: lying on his back on the floor, arms by the sides, legs straight, lower back pressed to the floor
hollow-body.end: lifts the shoulders and the straight legs a few inches off the floor, arms reaching past the head, lower back pressed to the floor, body shaped like a shallow banana, holding still
hollow-body.rule: The lower back stays pressed to the floor.
hollow-body.checks: Lombar colada no chão, braços e pernas estendidos, segura o tempo indicado

rotacao-russa.name: Russian twist
rotacao-russa.start: seated on the floor facing the camera, knees bent, heels on the floor, torso leaning back about 45 degrees with a straight back, hands clasped in front of the chest
rotacao-russa.end: rotates the shoulders to one side bringing the clasped hands beside the hip, torso still leaning back with a straight back
rotacao-russa.rule: The rotation comes from the torso; the knees stay still.
rotacao-russa.checks: Coluna reta, gira o tronco (não só os braços), pés no chão para iniciantes

lenhador-polia.name: high-to-low cable wood chop
lenhador-polia.scene: a cable station with a single handle on the high pulley
lenhador-polia.start: standing facing the camera with the high cable station to his right, feet wider than the shoulders, both hands holding the handle above the right shoulder, arms extended
lenhador-polia.end: pulls the handle diagonally down across the body to outside the left knee, rotating the torso and pivoting the right foot, arms extended
lenhador-polia.rule: The arms stay straight; the torso rotates.
lenhador-polia.checks: Braços estendidos, giro vem do tronco, pivota o pé de trás, volta controlada

flexao-lateral-halter.name: dumbbell side bend
flexao-lateral-halter.start: standing tall facing the camera, feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in the right hand at the side, left hand behind the head
flexao-lateral-halter.end: bends the torso straight sideways to the right, the dumbbell sliding down the outside of the right leg, without leaning forward or back
flexao-lateral-halter.rule: He bends only to the side, never forward or back.
flexao-lateral-halter.checks: Inclina só para o lado, sem ir para frente ou para trás, volta usando o lado oposto

caminhada-peso-unilateral.name: suitcase carry
caminhada-peso-unilateral.start: standing tall facing the camera, a heavy dumbbell in the right hand at the side, left arm relaxed
caminhada-peso-unilateral.end: walks forward with short steps, torso upright and level, not leaning toward the dumbbell
caminhada-peso-unilateral.rule: The torso stays upright and does not lean toward the weight.
caminhada-peso-unilateral.checks: Tronco reto sem inclinar para o lado do peso, ombros nivelados, passos curtos
